title: Repair-relays also repairs relays nested in reopenings and corrections
description: repair-relays also repairs relays nested in reopenings and corrections
acceptance_criteria: repair-relays puts back, or removes, a damaged relay in an approvals.json reopening's superseded_approval and in each approval a corrections.json correction embeds, keeping every reopening and correction; it prints approvals.json reopening <n> superseded approval and corrections.json correction <n> definition|closing approval, and --json names the nested record in within (red then green)
